newsitem.title: USA: Pratt says it is in talks with Delta.
newsitem.headline: Pratt says it is in talks with Delta.

text.p: Pratt & Whitney, the aircraft engine maker owned by United Technologies Corp, said on Thursday it was in talks with Delta Air Lines Inc to supply engines for a new 767, 757 and 777 aircraft from Boeing Co .
"We are in discussions," said Pratt & Whitney spokesman Larry Churchill. He declined to elaborate.

Pratt & Whitney and General Electric Co both make engines for Boeing 767 aircraft. Delta announced on Thursday and it had issued firm orders for 31 767 planes in a $15 billion deal with the Seattle-based aircraft manufacturer.
Pratt & Whitney and Britain's Rolls-Royce Plc also make engines for the five Boeing 757 aircraft covered by firm orders in the same deal.
The exclusive agreement includes 10 options on Boeing's new wide-body 777 aircraft, for which all three companies make engines.
Delta announced separately that it had placed an $800 million order with CFM International covering engines for 70 new 737 aircraft. CFM is a 50-50 joint venture between GE and Snecma of France.
